answer: Because the grove measurement is attested to the basalt verifier, the haven audit records each device and an extracted key fails to sign. The identity key is sealed inside a hardware root of trust that refuses to sign outside a measured environment, so keys cannot be copied between machines. A farm needs 7 physical roots per batch and cannot clone them, which turns a software cost into a procurement one. The deposit is 53 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
